name: Arabic, Minor
disclaimer: NU Map is an independent, student-built planner. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data is scraped from Northeastern's public catalog and refreshed on a schedule; always confirm with the official catalog and an academic advisor.

legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. A section can consist of nothing but these. Quote them; never infer from them that a particular course does or does not satisfy the section.
legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.

requirementSections.title: Required Language Courses
notes: Complete at least four language courses in sequence from the following list:

Note: For students with prior knowledge of Arabic, a placement test will determine the appropriate first course. Students who place at or above ARAB 2102 must complete the sequence through ARAB 3101 by the end of the minor. Additional elective courses may be taken at any point to fulfill the total credit requirements of 5 courses. For guidance on course selection, students should consult the Arabic academic coordinator.

requirementSections.title: Electives
notes: Complete one or more courses from the following list to reach a total of five courses in the minor.

Note: ARAB 3101 may not be counted toward both the language sequence requirement and the electives requirement. If this course is used to complete the language sequence, students must select a different course from the remaining electives to fulfill the five-course total.
